question.text: If Rf = 7%, Rm = 13%, and beta = 1.2, cost of equity via CAPM is:

explanation.text: The Logic: re = 7 + 1.2 * (13 - 7) = 7 + 7.2 = 14.2%. The Trap: Other values come from arithmetic slips. Cross-Exam Context: CAPM calc core to XV. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Cross-check cost of equity via dividend yield + growth as sanity test.
